articles.summary: Bilt is kicking off the month with up 125% transfer bonto Japan Airlines Mileage Bank, a new Bilt Cash upgrade option, a Chef Thomas Keller collaboration, free fitness classes, comedy nights, and double points on everyday spending. articles.title: Bilt March 2026 Rent Day: Up to 125% JAL transfer bonus, Chef Thomas Keller, and more
